name: Kämpfer
description: Natsuru is selected to be a Kampfer, a mystical fighter who has to fight other Kampfers. The catch is that all Kampfers are female, and Natsuru is male... at least he was! Worse, Natusru's best friend turns out to have a crush on his new body.

videos.title: Picture Drama: Entrails Fantastic Idea
videos.overview: The Entrails Animals and Akane discuss philosophical topics such as existence, purpose, and low-quality merchandise.

videos.title: I'd Like to See the Kampfer's Good Points
videos.overview:
The female Natsuru still has trouble getting used to her large bust. Akane offers to work part-time with her, to earn money for a new larger bras. But they get forced into a dubious job, and end up working at the Pure Café of Love and Dreams... where by some strange coincidence a mixer with some of their classmates takes place as well.

[Screened at the official Kämpfer event which took place at Odaiba Cinema Mediage, Tokyo on Sunday, March 6, 2011]

videos.title: The End Run
videos.overview:
Since Mikoto, Akane, and Shizuku have all fallen for Natsuru, the enemy White Kämpfer faction with Kaede tries to break the group apart by hypnotizing Mikoto and manipulating Natsuru.

[Screened at the official Kämpfer event which took place at Odaiba Cinema Mediage, Tokyo on Sunday, March 6, 2011]

videos.title: Destiny, the Chosen Ones
videos.overview: Natsuru Senō wakes up to discover one morning that he has transformed into a woman, upon which a stuffed animal tiger, Disemboweled Tiger, who introduces itself as a messenger, tells him that he has become a Kämpfer, which must do battle with other Kämpfer; since Kämpfer must be female, Natsuru transforms into a female version of himself.

videos.title: Glow, the Fight of Death Starts
videos.overview: Natsuru stops Akane from shooting Kaede and the attacker escapes when the bell for class rings. Natsuru realizes that the enemy also goes to his school and becomes wary of the danger and cautious of the other girls around him.

videos.title: Lily, the Secret Flower Garden
videos.overview: Natsuru begins his first day in the girls side of the school where he is transferred into Akane's class and is very popular among the girls. Kaede confesses her love to Natsuru, but he is unable to answer due to his bracelet flashing.

videos.title: Declaration of War, the Fighting Maidens
videos.overview: As the cultural festival comes up, Natsuru is shocked to find that Shizuku has entered him into the Miss Seitetsu beauty contest.

videos.title: Comedy, First Kiss
videos.overview: The cultural festival is about to begin and the class dress Natsuru and Akane in various costumes for the Miss Seitetsu beauty contest. In the changing room, Kaede interrupts the two of them and once again gets into an argument with Akane.

videos.title: Homecoming, are You My Friend or Enemy?
videos.overview: Natsuru is surprised to find his childhood friend Mikoto has returned. When Kämpfer Natsuru heads to school, she is forced to participate in a 'quasi-maid café'. She is later accompanied by Shizuku, who warns her that a new Kämpfer will be coming.

videos.title: Invite, the Uninvited Guests
videos.overview: Natsuru, unexpectedly accompanied by Akane and Shizuku, arrives at Kaede's house, which has a lot of Entrails Animals. Kaede starts things off with a game involving two people biting through the ends of a Pocky stick.

videos.title: Dearest, the First Date
videos.overview: Shizuku asks Male Natsuru to go out on a date with her. While Shizuku is generally insistent that it's a proper date, Natsuru just goes along with it thinking it is a plan to draw out the White Kämpfer.

videos.title: Midsummer, Tropical Cyclone of Love
videos.overview: Akane is having a romantic summer date with male Natsuru at the pool. However, Mikoto, Shizuku and Kaede show up as well.

videos.title: Fall, a Summer Experience
videos.overview: Natsuru finds himself sitting next to Kaede outside the hotel, who hypnotizes him into making Shizuku his.

videos.title: To Choose, a Song of Happiness
videos.overview: Shizuku invites Natsuru over to her house to tell her about Kaede, getting Kaede's Burnt To Death Lion to spill the beans about the Kämpfer system.

videos.title: Christmas, the Miracle of the Entrails Dolls
videos.overview: Natsuru wakes up on Christmas Eve morning to find out that he and his messenger, Disemboweled Tiger, have swapped bodies!
